explication: Paradev is a desktop-centered workspace for running CLI coding agents, with review and preview tools, remote access, mobile control, and scheduled or event-triggered automation. A typical workflow starts when a user creates a workspace and launches an agent; the user then reviews changes and may preview the app before committing. The graph preserves the README’s other major product branches. Several implementation paths are mapped from the repository tree rather than inspected source, so edges rely on documented README workflows and do not imply unsampled internal call chains.
